## European Cups

### Alba Berlin Hosts Hannover in Crucial DBBL Matchup

Alba Berlin will look to bounce back from a narrow 81-82 EuroCup loss to Castors Braine on Wednesday when they host Hannover in a DBBL matchup on Saturday. The match will be a reunion for Theresa Simon, who played for Alba Berlin and will now face her former team. Hannover has struggled this season, having lost Lashae Dwyer in the summer, but have been boosted by the addition of US players Prencis Harden and Nora Francois, who have taken on key roles. Alba Berlin's Alyssa Brown is the top scorer for the team, having played for Hannover last season. Tipoff is scheduled for 6 PM on Saturday, with Dyn Basketball providing live and free coverage on YouTube.

## Around the League

### Rostock Seawolves Support Anti-Violence Campaign

The Rostock Seawolves basketball team, along with three other women's teams from different sports, participated in a unique event called Quattroball on November 25, 2026, to raise awareness and funds against violence against women. The event, held at the StadtHalle Rostock, drew a crowd of nearly 1,000 people and raised €10,000 for the cause. The teams, which included players from the 1. Regionalliga Nord, 2. Handball-Bundesliga, and 3. Liga, competed in their respective sports and also participated in challenges and a cross-sport competition. The event was part of the international campaign 'Orange the World' and coincided with the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women, which commemorates the Mirabal sisters who fought against the dictatorship in the Dominican Republic in 1960.

Sources:

- [Rostock Seawolves: Quattroball zum Orange Day bringt 10.000 Euro gegen Gewalt an Frauen](https://www.seawolves.de/quattroball-zum-orange-day-bringt-10-000-euro-gegen-gewalt-an-frauen)

### Bamberg Baskets' Freak Week Offers Discounts on PUMA Basketball Shoes

The Bamberg Baskets are hosting a Freak Week promotion, which includes discounts on PUMA basketball shoes. On Shoe Thursday, customers can find various PUMA basketball shoe models reduced by up to 70%. Additionally, the team's Sockenbox is available for €11.95, and Craft-Basketballsocken are priced at €4.95 per pair. The promotion runs until Monday, with new deals added daily on the team's online shop and Instagram account.

### Hagen Considers Building New Arena for Basketball Teams

The city of Hagen is moving forward with plans to build a new multi-purpose arena, with a potential capacity of 5,000 spectators. The project is being driven by the city's mayor, Dennis Rehbein, who has been in talks with basketball teams Phoenix Hagen and VfL Eintracht Hagen. The teams have been successful in representing the city beyond its borders, and the arena could provide a long-term perspective for top-level sports and a new attraction for sports, culture, and events. The city council will now consider the Westside area as a preferred location for the arena, with a focus on its accessibility and development opportunities. The next steps will involve a more in-depth examination of the site and its potential, with results to be presented to the city's political bodies for further discussion and decision-making.

Sources:

- [Phoenix Hagen: Mehrzweckhalle Westside: Stadt Hagen bringt Vorzugsstandort in die politische Beratung ein](https://www.phoenix-hagen.de/mehrzweckhalle-westside-stadt-hagen-bringt-vorzugsstandort-in-die-politische-beratung-ein)

### Gladiators Trier Strengthen Business Network

The VET-CONCEPT Gladiators Trier have strengthened their business network by integrating their Gladiators Business Club into their sponsorship packages. Starting from the 2026/27 season, all sponsors and partners will automatically be part of the Business Club, benefiting from various networking events, exclusive events, and exchange opportunities around the Trierer basketball. The club's development will be led by Daniel Schiller, who will oversee the club's administration and organize events and networking activities. The Gladiators Trier aim to further strengthen the connection within their partner network, create new contacts and business opportunities, and provide additional value to their partners. The Business Club has seen positive development since its introduction in 2023, contributing to the growth and networking of the partner structure.

Sources:

- [Vet-Concept Gladiators Trier: Gladiators Trier stärken ihr Business-Netzwerk.](https://vetconceptgladiators.de/gladiators-trier-staerken-ihr-business-netzwerk)

### Telekom Baskets Bonn Offers 20% Discount on Tickets and Merchandise

The Telekom Baskets Bonn are offering a 20% discount on tickets and merchandise during their Black Weekend promotion. From November 27 to 29, fans can save on tickets for three home games: the BBL Cup quarterfinal against Frankfurt on December 12, and league games against Oldenburg on January 9 and Vechta on January 30. To receive the discount, fans must enter the code BLACKWEEKEND-T5J5UF in the online ticket shop. Additionally, a 20% discount is available on team merchandise, including current team wear and Bonn-themed items, in the online fanshop.

Sources:

- [Telekom Baskets Bonn: Black Weekend: 20 Prozent Rabatt auf Tickets und Fanartikel](https://www.telekom-baskets-bonn.de/presse/newsarchiv/black-weekend-20-prozent-rabatt-auf-tickets-und-fanartikel)
